title: Grothendieck abelian strict-system categories
statement:
For every inverse sequence B of sheaves of commutative rings in universe w on the stated essentially w-small site, the actual strict semilinear system category is Grothendieck abelian in universe w.

Precise formal conclusion with its module-variable context (notation is that of the cited statement dependencies):
```lean
universe u v w
variable {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
  [EssentiallySmall.{w} C]
  [J.HasSheafCompose (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})]
  [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{w}] [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
theorem strictRingSystem_isGrothendieckAbelian
    (B : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ Sheaf J CommRingCat.{w}) :
    IsGrothendieckAbelian.{w} (StrictRingSystem B)
```
